subject.title: fix(commands): re-check owner for cross-channel /allowlist writes

question: Should channel-, account-, and context-derived owners be limited to their exact origin scope for `/allowlist` mutations, while configured `commands.ownerAllowFrom` identities, its wildcard, and gateway `operator.admin` retain cross-scope authority?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this establishes a permanent privilege and upgrade contract that tests and contributor intent cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve exact-scope ownership
options.body: Require target ownership whenever channel or account changes while preserving configured global and gateway-admin authority.

options.title: Require named global owners
options.body: Allow cross-scope writes only for named `commands.ownerAllowFrom` identities or gateway admin, excluding wildcard global ownership.

options.title: Preserve broader ownership
options.body: Continue allowing origin-derived owners to administer other scopes and explicitly accept the security boundary and compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-scope ownership
recommendation.body: Require target ownership whenever channel or account changes while preserving configured global and gateway-admin authority.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the deepest sampled merged history across command authorization, allowlist handling, and config-write policy.
